_comment: Open Design MCP server for Chief of Staff (Jarvis). Open Design ships with this app as a git submodule at third_party/open-design (build it once with ./scripts/setup-open-design.sh). Copy the 'open-design' entry below into your Kiro MCP config: workspace .kiro/settings/mcp.json or user ~/.kiro/settings/mcp.json. The MCP server is a stdio proxy to the local Open Design daemon; the app starts that daemon on demand via 'call my design shop'. Adjust --daemon-url if you run the daemon on a different port.
